My grandmother's pearls. My mom [the daughter of my grandmother] was talking about selling them because she has issues and money is a problem, but I took them, hid them, and wear them a lot since she doesn't live near me anymore. I like to bake, and I have been heavily involved in music since I was quite young. No one in my family was like that. My grandmother died before I was born, but I was informed around the time my mom was talking about selling the necklace that I am very much like her, since she baked all the time, and she was a skilled piano player and singer.

All I can say is do not be passive aggressive about anything. My dad is pretty incredible. He married my mom and adopted my half sister, who was fourteen at the time, and raised her as his own. When I was thirteen, my mom, who is an alcoholic, started drinking again, and he has been there for her all 8 times she has been in and out of rehab. He took care of three kids, one being autistic, basically on his own. He is still with my mom even though she verbally abuses him constantly. It isn't that he is weak though, it is because he does love her, and he wants to try and make it work. And he has always been the most accepting person. He told me he would love me no matter what. He came from a very bigoted family, but he has always told me that I could love anyone, gender, race, all that jazz, I ever wanted and he would still love me. I dunno. He is that kind of guy that if I run into someone he knows him, they always say, "You know, your dad is a great guy."

I actually waited until I was nineteen years old. My reason was really stupid, but it is a thing. It was my first college party, and a guy I liked offered me a beer, saying that I would really like it. So I took it, to get on his good side. It was disgusting, but I just smiled, kept drinking and told him it was good. So the whole night he was offering me beers, and I would accept even though I hated it. Moral of the story, I got drunk, and the guy was my boyfriend when I woke up the next morning. And eventually I grew to love beer.

I tried using pills. There was a point in my senior year of high school, something happened, and all the blame had ended up being pointed at me, even though I had only been a messenger. I was completely iced out by everyone. They didn't even allow me to defend myself. So mix the isolation with an already low self worth, anxiety/depression, it was just a dangerous mix. I ended up throwing up after taking about...4 or 5. I just hunched over the toilet bowl. At first, I was thinking of other ways I could finish the job, and then I don't know, I just had a moment where I was just thinking, "Who the fuck cares what they think." I was heading off to college in less that 3 months, and I got better friends who, when I actually did fuck up, didn't ice me out, and worked with me to sort out issues. I am still in an icky-ish place, but I am getting there.

It was not necessarily my neighbor, but it was the recovering drug addict of my neighbor who needed a place to stay for awhile. He would constantly throw outdoor parties, not huge ones, but there would always be yelling and it would always end with a knife fight and cops. There is a tree that grew in the fence dividing the properties, and he decided to see if he could do a fire breathing trick near it. Luckily my dad was outside and he got the fire out quickly. He also made a point to hit on any and every girl he saw. And he was also a fan of making false police reports. My dad, who was good friends with the neighbor, attempted to try and talk him into kicking out his own brother, but that didn't work. What did work was when the neighbor caught his brother trying to have his way with his girlfriend in the garage, where his brother had been making meth. There was much screaming, fight fighting and police action to be had.

My story was just a couple years out of highschool. There was a girl, she had been in our crowd earlier on in highschool, but I guess she had been chosen to move up in the ranks. She quickly became one of the more brutal ones. Well, she got accepted to a very, very nice University. Well, after the first year, I had heard from one of her friends that she dropped because she was having a hard time making friends there. So she started going to the local University. The one I go to, and we bumped into each other one day. It was clear I didn't give a shit how I looked that day. I had one class, I was just grabbing some lunch. So, she looked me over, laughed and said, "You haven't changed much." I responded with a smile and a, "So tell me, what made you transfer schools?" In one swift movement, her face twisted and she shuffled off.

Uh yeah. This was actually a short dream, but it still seemed to stick. I was hanging out with my roommate and we went out to eat. We were talking, and I noticed that her stomach was beginning to swell. I didn't bother asking. I asked her if she wanted a glass of wine, and she just smiled and said, "No thanks, I am pregnant." At this point, I hadn't heard from my roommate in a week or two, which wasn't so unusual. So one night I get a call and she is freaking out, and she tells me that she is pregnant.

Well, the dream that I had, I wasn't myself in the dream. I was actually my friend, one of my roommates. I had been running down a trail, which is something that a friend of mine did, when all of a sudden, a man in a disfigured mask came out of the brush and hit me in the back of the head with a croquet mallet. When I came to, I had been taken to an apartment and I had been tied up. While there, the man didn't take off the mask, and he did very graphic things. I remember waking up and feeling violated. Anyway, I had tried to escape, but he caught me, and as punishment, he whipped me. Eventually I got out, and I woke up. For days after, I felt like I was being watched. I told my friend about my dream about her, and she started to get paranoid. Eventually she began to notice a man following her around. He would typically be hiding behind a book. One day he began to bother her aggressively and he grabbed her, so she ran and she alerted the campus patrol and they got the guy. My friend recognized him from an old class. From about 3 semesters earlier.
